title: Normalized transport of tensor-pullback sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U,V$ objects of its small etale site and $a:V\to U$ an $X$-morphism. Use the tensor pullbacks, adjunction unit on global sections $a^*$ and normalized restriction $\rho_a$ of [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. There is an additive equivalence $e:\Gamma(V,a^*U^*F)\cong\Gamma(V,V^*F)$ such that $e(b\,a^*m)=b\,\rho_a(m)$ for every $m\in\Gamma(U,U^*F)$ and $b\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$. No affine or quasi-coherence hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 03DR, equation-quasi-coherent-presheaf: restriction through the canonical composition isomorphism of pullbacks

proof.text: Construct sectionsEquiv for an arbitrary module isomorphism k by evaluating k.hom and k.inv at the whole scheme. The two inverse identities follow by evaluating k.hom_inv_id and k.inv_hom_id, and scalar compatibility is Hom.app_smul. For an arbitrary family L of module functors, composition comparisons c and additive unit maps eta, form k = (c a.left U.hom).app F followed by eqToIso along a.w. Use sectionsEquiv_smul and sectionsEquiv_apply to prove its scalar-unit equation; evaluation of the composite module morphism is the composite of the section maps. All these steps are completely proved in Lean with abstract module objects, including the zero module and empty schemes.

Specialize the proved family calculation to tensorPullback, tensorSectionsComp and tensorSectionsUnit. Prove restriction_eq as the definitional equality of additive maps, then rewrite that map equality inside the proved result. This gives precisely etaleTensorSectionsRestriction in the equation without repeatedly normalizing the concrete scalar-module data. No new hypothesis, unproved transport equation, or remaining hole is introduced.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etaleTensorSectionsTransport {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules)
    {U V : X.Etale} (a : V ⟶ U) :
    ∃ e : Γ((tensorPullback a.left).obj ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj F), ⊤) ≃+
      Γ((tensorPullback V.hom).obj F, ⊤),
      ∀ (m : Γ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)) (b : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
        e (b • tensorSectionsUnit a.left ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj F) m) =
          b • etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F a m
